summary: The call on 2026-04-28 was between Northwind AE Rahul and VP Engineering Anjali Rao. Anjali informed that Meridian Payments has decided to go with Stratify. She cited two reasons: pricing volatility that eroded trust with CFO Vikram Desai, and a delayed SOC2 delivery that upset CISO Farhan Sheikh. Rahul asked if anything could reopen the discussion, but Anjali said not this year, leaving the deal at risk.

objections.text: Pricing kept moving — once it dropped twenty percent on day one, he stopped believing the list price meant anything.
The security review slipped a whole cycle because the SOC2 came three weeks late, indicating Northwind didn't treat security as a priority.

competitors.name: Stratify
competitors.context: Chosen by prospect; cited for consistent pricing and faster SOC2 Type I documentation turnaround
